remarks:
Just bring your suitcase. This move-in-ready 2-bedroom, 1-bath ranch home at 117 Worthy Ave in Medina, NY can be sold fully furnished—right down to the silverware. Currently being used as an Airbnb, the home offers a comfortable, efficient layout with everything already in place for its next owner.

The kitchen features a butcher block countertop, with the refrigerator and stove included. A washer and dryer are also included for added convenience. Outside, a covered patio provides a great spot to relax or entertain, while the shed offers useful storage space. With the option to purchase the home complete with its indoor and outdoor furniture, décor, kitchenware, and other furnishings, this is a truly turnkey property.

Located in Orleans County near State Street Park and the Erie Canal, the property offers convenient access to outdoor recreation and local amenities. Whether you’re looking for a primary residence, a low-maintenance getaway, or an investment property, this home offers plenty of flexibility without a lot of upkeep.

Showings are limited to days/times when the property has no guests.

The listing agent is also the seller.
